text:
QUOTE: `archivedChannelsViewable(value)` is `value !== 'false'` (`app/queries/servers/system.ts:304`). Only the exact string `'false'` turns the feature off. `true`, any other string, and `undefined` all turn it on.
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer states that only 'false' disables the feature and that a missing (undefined) setting results in archived channels being viewable.
